messages:
ria: Quick usability recap from a handful of signups today — the first-run hero and the 'launchpad templates' area is being ignored. People call the small link 'invisible'. cole: Yep. Observed the same in session 2. They assume templates are documentation, not runnable projects. The phrase 'Add sample' is the culprit. tegan: Two low-effort fixes I want to try: (1) swap the text link for a solid primary CTA 'Get a runnable demo' and (2) show two real thumbnails with captions 'Echo bot' and 'QA assistant' so users see concrete outcomes. yusuf: Accessibility note: keyboard focus currently lands on the top nav. The hero's interactive elements come later in tab order. Also, screen reader reads "Launchpad templates" but there's no announced action. ria: Proposed microcopy: primary button = 'Get a runnable demo', secondary = 'Create an empty project'. Explainer copy under CTA: 'Includes prompts, a demo endpoint, and a quick README — ready in under a minute.' Keep it short. cole: Also change internal wording from 'sample' to 'starter' or 'template'. 'Runnable demo' tested well in research — lower jargon. tegan: UX mock idea: Variant A = 2 thumbnails + CTA left, Variant B = single large device screenshot + three bullets on the right. We'll metric: click-through, import completion, time-to-first-model-call. yusuf: A11y checklist: make CTA a native Includes prompts, a demo endpoint, and a quick README.
``` ria: Front-end note: thumbnails should lazy-load low-res placeholders (LQIP) from CDN. If thumbnails fail, fall back to a neutral illustration. Keep total bytes small. cole: Quick copy variants for testing: V1 'Get a runnable demo', V2 'Import starter project', V3 'Browse launchpad templates'. We'll localize later. tegan: Tests to add: onboarding-e2e — hero CTA is first tabbable element, preview modal traps focus, import completion announced, and contrast checks for button meet 4.5:1. yusuf: I'll add the a11y acceptance criteria and keyboard shortcut suggestion (press 1 = import demo) but will double-check for conflicts. onboarding-bot: Task created: PRO-4120 "Hero launchpad: improve CTA clarity + accessibility" assigned to ria/cole/tegan/yusuf. Due 2026-04-12. :white_check_mark: ria: I'll drop quick mocks for A/B in #design-review by tomorrow midday and include the thumbnails. Ping me if you want early access to the prototype branch.
